messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take metformin exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose. Use the medicine exactly as directed.
Take metformin with a meal, unless your doctor tells you otherwise. Some forms of metformin are taken only once daily with the evening meal. Follow your doctor's instructions.
Take immediate release tablets in divided doses 2 to 3 times a day with meals. Your dose will be increased slowly to minimise gastrointestinal side effects.
Do not crush, chew, or break an extended-release tablet. Swallow it whole.
Measure liquid medicine carefully. Shake the oral suspension before you measure a dose. Use the dosing syringe provided, or use a medicine dose-measuring device (not a kitchen spoon).
Some tablets are made with a shell that is not absorbed or melted in the body. Part of this shell may appear in your stool. This is normal and will not make the medicine less effective.
Triplet: ["metformin", "tablet shell", "not absorbed in body"]

The relation 'tablet shell' in the triplet is defined as 'The tablet shell of the subject drug is not absorbed in the body and may be excreted in the stool.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'if missed as tablet': If a dose of the subject drug is missed and it is administered as a tablet, the missed dose should not be taken.
B. 'capsule should not be': The subject medication's capsule must not be crushed, chewed, broken, or opened.
C. 'crushed tablet should not be': A crushed tablet of the subject medication should not be saved for later use.
D. 'oral solution should not be measured': The oral solution of the subject medication should not be measured using a kitchen spoon.
E. 'should not be taken': The subject drug should not be taken in the form or combination specified by the object entity.
